purpose: Execution limits for QA and explanation requests (RN-04). Read by ehr_evidence_app.evidence.contracts; each value must lie within the fixed ceiling in code. A request outside a limit ends with an explicit outcome. On the generation path a prompt over its budget, output cut off at its limit, a timeout or resource exhaustion ends the model's attempt, and the template candidate answers as a recorded fallback (ADR 0012). The prompt, output and time limits were set on the development case sets and are frozen for the final evaluation (ADR 0015).
